criteria.en: You keep going without long silences and cover the cue card fully, but there are filled pauses ("em") before reasons. Practise linking phrases so you can launch a reason smoothly.
criteria.zhNote: 你能持续说、没有长时间沉默，也完整覆盖了话题卡，但在给理由前有填充停顿（"em"）。练习衔接短语，让你能顺畅地开启一个理由。
quotes: "because... em... because it makes me relax"
"and then, you know, I just go there"

criteria.en: Everyday vocabulary is used accurately, but "I like" repeats and limits the range. Bring in "I'm really into", "I'm keen on", "I'm a big fan of" to show flexibility.
criteria.zhNote: 日常词汇使用准确，但"I like"重复，限制了词汇范围。加入"I'm really into"、"I'm keen on"、"I'm a big fan of"来展示灵活度。
quotes: "I like pop, I like rock, and I like jazz"

criteria.en: Simple sentences are accurate, and you attempt some complex forms. A wider range of relative and conditional clauses would raise this to Band 7.
criteria.zhNote: 简单句准确，也尝试了一些复杂句。用更多关系从句和条件句能把这项提到 7 分。
quotes: "It is a place where I can relax when I feel tired"

criteria.en: Not assessed in this practice run — pronunciation requires real audio analysis, which is not available here.
criteria.zhNote: 本次练习不评分——发音需要真实音频分析，此处不可用。

weaks.quote: "I like pop, I like rock, and I like jazz"
weaks.tip: Vary your verbs and intensifiers instead of repeating "I like": "I'm really into...", "I'm a big fan of...".

weaks.quote: "because... em... because it makes me relax"
weaks.tip: Practise linking phrases so you can start a reason smoothly without filled pauses.

weaks.quote: "you know, it is a good escape"
weaks.tip: Replace fillers like "you know" and "em" with real discourse markers ("on top of that", "in other words").

p1.ans: Yes, I like music a lot. I listen to it every day, especially when I am on the bus. It helps me relax because... em... because it makes me feel calm after a long day.
p1.en: Clear, relevant answer with a reason and an example. To push higher, remove the filled pause before "because" and extend with one more detail.
p1.zh: 回答清晰、切题，有理由也有例子。想提分可去掉"because"前的填充停顿，再补一个细节。
tags: A filled pause ("em") interrupts the flow before your reason. Practise linking straight into "because".
给理由前有填充停顿（"em"）打断了流畅度。练习直接衔接"because"。
Good everyday phrasing: "helps me relax", "feel calm".
日常表达不错："helps me relax"、"feel calm"。
Accurate simple sentences with a correct causal clause.
简单句准确，因果从句用对了。

p1.ans: I like pop, I like rock, and I like jazz. It depends on my mood. When I am happy I like pop, and when I want to relax I like jazz music.
p1.en: Good range of genres named. The repetition of "I like" weakens lexical variety — try "I'm really into" or "I'm keen on".
p1.zh: 列举了不同曲风，很好。"I like" 重复削弱了词汇多样性 — 可换 "I'm really into" 或 "I'm keen on"。
tags: "I like" is repeated three times. Vary with "I'm really into", "I'm a big fan of" to lift Lexical Resource.
"I like" 重复三次。用 "I'm really into"、"I'm a big fan of" 变换，提升词汇分。
Smooth delivery, no long pauses, ideas connect naturally.
表达顺畅，无长停顿，观点自然衔接。
Correct use of a "when" clause to contrast moods.
用 "when" 从句对比心情，语法正确。

p2.ans: I would like to talk about a small park near my home. It is a place where I can relax when I feel tired. I go there almost every weekend, usually on Sunday morning. When I am there I walk around the lake, take some photos, and sometimes read a book on a bench. I enjoy it because it is quiet and the air is fresh, and, you know, it is a good escape from the busy city life.
p2.en: A strong long turn: all four cue-card points are covered and the answer runs the full 1–2 minutes. Good use of one relative clause. To reach Band 7, add a wider range of complex sentences and cut fillers ("you know").
p2.zh: 很棒的长陈述：话题卡四个要点全覆盖，时长撑满 1–2 分钟，用了一个关系从句。要冲 7 分，多用复杂句、去掉填充语（"you know"）。
tags: You sustain the full long turn without hesitation — strong fluency for the cue card.
你能撑满整段长陈述且无迟疑——话题卡的流利度很好。
The filler "you know" recurs. Replace with real discourse markers ("in fact", "for instance").
填充语 "you know" 反复出现。换成真正的衔接语（"in fact"、"for instance"）。
Mostly simple sentences. Add relative/conditional clauses to widen grammatical range for Band 7.
以简单句为主。加入关系从句/条件从句拓宽句式，冲 7 分。

p3.q: Why do people like to visit different places?
p3.ans: I think people like to visit different places because they want to experience new things. Em… also they can learn about different cultures and try different food.
p3.en: Good reasons, but "em" and the lack of an example keep this at Band 6. Add one concrete example (e.g. a trip you took).
p3.zh: 理由不错，但 "em" 和缺少例子让它停在 6 分。补一个具体例子（比如你去过的一次旅行）。
tags: Ideas connect with "because" and "also", but the filled pause "Em…" breaks the flow.
观点用 "because"、"also" 衔接，但填充停顿 "Em…" 打断了流畅度。
Basic but accurate: "experience new things", "different cultures".
基础但准确："experience new things"、"different cultures"。

p3.q: Do you think tourism can harm local cultures?
p3.ans: Yes, sometimes. When too many tourists come, local traditions may become just a show for money, and prices go up for local people.
p3.en: Strong turn — a clear position with two developed consequences. This is Band 7 quality; do this consistently.
p3.zh: 很棒的一回合——立场清晰，还展开了两个后果。这已是 7 分水平，保持稳定即可。
tags: Two consequences in one breath, no fillers — coherent and controlled.
一口气给出两个后果、没有填充词——连贯且控制得当。
Well-formed "when" clause plus a coordinated second clause.
"when" 从句结构完整，第二个分句并列得当。

p3.q: How might tourism change in the future?
p3.ans: Maybe it will be more online, like virtual reality tours, so people can see places without travelling so much.
p3.en: A clear prediction with an example. Use a stronger future form ("is likely to", "may well") instead of "maybe" to lift grammar.
p3.zh: 预测明确还带了例子。把 "maybe" 换成更强的将来表达（"is likely to"、"may well"）能提升语法分。
tags: "Maybe" plus "will" is safe but limited; try "is likely to".
"Maybe" 加 "will" 稳妥但单一；可试 "is likely to"。
Short but complete, with a supporting example.
简短但完整，且带例子支撑。

p3.q: What are the differences between travelling in your own country and abroad?
p3.ans: Travelling at home is cheaper and easier because there is no language problem, but abroad you see completely different buildings and food, so it feels more exciting.
p3.en: A clear comparison with two sides. Link them with a discourse marker ("On the other hand") instead of "but" to show a wider range.
p3.zh: 对比清楚、两面都谈到了。把 "but" 换成衔接语（"On the other hand"）能展示更宽的句式范围。
tags: "cheaper and easier", "completely different" are natural everyday collocations.
"cheaper and easier"、"completely different" 是很自然的日常搭配。
Two clauses joined by "because" and "so" — accurate but simple.
用 "because"、"so" 连接两个分句，准确但偏简单。

p3.q: How has the way people travel changed over the past few decades?
p3.ans: Nowadays people book everything online and they travel much more often, because flights are cheaper than before.
p3.en: Relevant and well organised. Add a second change (e.g. shorter trips, social media) so the answer does not rely on one idea.
p3.zh: 切题、结构清楚。再补一个变化（比如短途旅行、社交媒体）会让回答不只依赖一个观点。
tags: A single developed idea; a second point would strengthen the turn.
只有一个展开的观点；再补一点会更有力。
"book everything online", "much more often" show good range.
"book everything online"、"much more often" 用词不错。

p3.q: Should governments invest more in local tourism?
p3.ans: I think they should, because tourism creates jobs for local people, and it also helps to protect traditional culture.
p3.en: A clear position with two benefits. Add "for instance" before an example to make the structure even clearer.
p3.zh: 立场明确、给出两点好处。在例子前加 "for instance" 会让结构更清晰。
tags: Two benefits presented in parallel — good signposting.
两点好处并列呈现——衔接到位。
"creates jobs"、"protect traditional culture" 用词贴题。

p3.q: What are the negative effects of too much tourism?
p3.ans: Too many visitors can damage natural areas. For example, beaches and mountains get polluted, and wildlife is disturbed by crowds.
p3.en: Good use of "For example" and two consequences. Push to Band 7 by adding a conditional ("unless we limit numbers").
p3.zh: "For example" 用得好，也给了两个后果。想冲 7 分可补一个条件句（"unless we limit numbers"）。
tags: The example marker "For example" lifts coherence.
例子标记 "For example" 提升了连贯性。
被动语态 "is disturbed" 使用正确。

p3.q: Why do some people prefer to stay at home rather than travel?
p3.ans: Some people feel safe at home. They do not like changes, and travelling can be expensive, so they just relax in their own city.
p3.en: Reasons are listed but a little general. Extend one of them with a personal detail to sound less rehearsed.
p3.zh: 理由列出来了但偏笼统。挑一个补上个人细节，听起来才不像背答案。
tags: Repetition of "they" and simple verbs keeps this at Band 6.
"they" 反复出现、动词偏简单，停在 6 分。
Ideas are listed rather than developed.

p3.q: How important is tourism to a country’s economy?
p3.ans: It is quite important, because tourists spend money on hotels, food and transport, which supports many small businesses.
p3.en: A well-built answer: a clear claim plus a relative clause ("which supports…") that shows grammatical range.
p3.zh: 结构完整：先给结论，再用关系从句（"which supports…"）展示句式范围。
tags: Non-defining "which" clause used correctly — Band 7 feature.
非限定 "which" 从句用得正确——7 分特征。
"small businesses", "spend money on" are precise and natural.
"small businesses"、"spend money on" 准确自然。

p3.q: Do you think travel will become more popular in the future?
p3.ans: I believe it will become more popular, because travelling is getting cheaper, and more people can afford to see other countries.
p3.en: A confident close with a reason. Finish with a short summary of your view to end the discussion cleanly.
p3.zh: 结尾自信并给了理由。最后用一句话小结你的观点，能让整段讨论收得更干净。
tags: A clear closing position, but the turn ends without a summary.
立场清晰，但没有小结就结束了。
"afford to see other countries" is a good range marker.
"afford to see other countries" 是很好的词汇范围标记。

p3Overall.en: A genuine two-way discussion: you engage with each follow-up and give reasons, which suits Part 3. Ideas stay a little general and there is some hesitation ("em"). To reach Band 7, extend each point with an example and use discourse markers ("On top of that", "That said") instead of fillers.
p3Overall.zh: 这是一段真正的双向讨论：你对每个追问都有回应并给出理由，符合 Part 3 的要求。观点偏笼统、且有迟疑（"em"）。要冲 7 分，每个观点补一个例子，并用衔接语（"On top of that"、"That said"）代替填充词。
